observations: Photo 0: Blue PlayStation 4 console box with large “10” text and PlayStation logo; no visible model variant (Slim/Pro/Fat) on the box in this shot.
Photo 1: Blue PS4 DualShock-style controller shown in front of the blue box; controller color matches the “customised” claim.
Photo 2: Another angle of the blue PS4 box; PlayStation logo visible; still no clear console model/variant text.

claims.claim: Blue Customised Ps4 slim with 10 latest games.
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue PS4-themed box and controllers, but no photo shows the console model (Slim vs Fat/Pro) or the actual 10 games.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo of seals/serials/opening status; only box/controller images.
No running/temperature test or port-by-port demonstration shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Photos show at least one blue controller, but do not show “original pads” set count, and no UK receipt is shown.

claims.claim: Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.
claims.evidence: No game discs/cases or screenshots/library list shown.

risks.risk: Console variant may not be PS4 Slim (could be Fat/Pro) — photos only show a box and controllers, not the console itself.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual console label/serial sticker showing the model/variant (and a photo of the console ports).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case PS4 bundle with uncertain variant and no confirmed game list.

risks.risk: “10 latest games” may be untrue or may be downloads/duplicates; could be fewer discs or different titles.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the game discs (or a screenshot of the PS4 library with 10 titles) matching the seller’s list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a console with no confirmed games (or minimal value games).

risks.risk: “All ports working” may be false (HDMI/USB ports common failure).
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI connected to TV + at least one USB device working (e.g., charging controller/USB storage) and audio/video output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working ports.

risks.risk: “No overheating” can’t be verified remotely without a stress test.
risks.proof: Short gameplay/benchmark video (10–20 minutes) with the console running and no shutdown; ideally show fan behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: “Original pads” and “UK receipt” may be missing or not original.
risks.proof: Photos of both controllers (front/back) and a clear photo of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed original and receipt not included.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 console (front/back) and a close-up of the model/serial label to confirm Slim vs Fat/Pro.
Photo/video showing all ports working: HDMI output on a TV + USB port test (USB device or charging) + audio working.
Screenshot or video of the PS4 game library showing the exact 10 games (or photos of all discs/cases).
Photo of both controllers (pads) and a clear photo of the UK receipt (if it exists).
Short running test video (10–20 minutes) to show no overheating/shutdown.
response.reason: The photos only confirm a blue PS4-themed box and controllers; they do not confirm the console variant, the number/titles of games, or that ports and overheating status are truly good. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
